scenes.vo: One Indian opener now has Test hundreds in all four SENA countries. Just one.
scenes.cap: One Indian opener now has Test 100s in all 4 SENA countries.

scenes.vo: SENA means South Africa, England, New Zealand and Australia.
scenes.cap: SENA = South Africa, England, New Zealand, Australia

scenes.vo: In Wellington, KL Rahul hit his thirteenth Test hundred, and became the first Indian opener to complete the set.
scenes.cap: Wellington: KL Rahul's 13th Test 100. First Indian opener to do it.

scenes.vo: Only five Indians have done it at all. Azharuddin, Tendulkar, Dravid, Kohli. And now Rahul.
scenes.cap: Only 5 Indians: Azharuddin, Tendulkar, Dravid, Kohli, Rahul

scenes.vo: He's also just the third Indian, after Gavaskar and Surinder Amarnath, to score a hundred in his first Test innings in New Zealand.
scenes.cap: 3rd Indian with a 100 in his first Test innings in NZ

scenes.vo: At tea on day three, India were three forty four for two. Only twenty four behind New Zealand's three sixty eight, with eight wickets left.
scenes.cap: Tea, Day 3: India 344/2, trailing NZ's 368 by just 24

scenes.vo: Ten of his thirteen hundreds came away from home. Which one was his best?
scenes.cap: 10 of his 13 Test 100s came away from home
